source: prices.runescape.wiki OSRS RuneLite data via market_universe + cached catalyst_state
objective: Rank long-horizon, catalyst-backed GP parking opportunities separately from fast flips and evergreen mean reversion. Cash remains the benchmark and speculative positions are never mandatory.

portfolio_policy.rule: Speculative parks require an explicit catalyst thesis, bounded sizing, patient entry, invalidation and acceptable RuneLite freshness/liquidity. They do not enter the normal capital frontier while allocation_authoritative=false.

top_candidates.name: Toxic staff of the dead (uncharged)
top_candidates.thesis: Toxic variant adds venom and defensive/special-attack utility while retaining the same elemental catalyst exposure.
top_candidates.invalidation: Legacy standard-spell hardware loses Raid 4 relevance or toxic variant demand fails to track catalyst progress.

top_candidates.name: Inquisitor's plateskirt
top_candidates.thesis: High-conviction Crush armour exposure with the same catalyst logic as the helm/hauberk; only one or two pieces should be owned within the theme cap.
top_candidates.invalidation: Crush relevance fails to translate into Inquisitor armour demand or new armour directly displaces it.

top_candidates.name: Staff of the dead
top_candidates.thesis: Cheap legacy elemental weapon with special-attack and standard-spell optionality if Raid 4 rewards increase elemental casting demand.
top_candidates.invalidation: New Raid 4 gear makes the staff mechanically irrelevant or price rises materially without supporting utility evidence.

top_candidates.name: Inquisitor's hauberk
top_candidates.thesis: High-conviction Crush armour exposure, but higher unit cost requires a deeper patient bid and theme-level concentration control.
top_candidates.invalidation: Crush relevance fails to translate into Inquisitor armour demand or new armour directly displaces it.

top_candidates.name: Tome of fire (empty)
top_candidates.thesis: Elemental off-hand optionality with a low absolute unit price; attractive only when not already crowded by catalyst buying.
top_candidates.invalidation: Zorya's Tome or other Raid 4 rewards directly dominate legacy tomes, or price momentum outruns confirmed utility.

top_candidates.name: Tome of earth (empty)
top_candidates.thesis: Low-unit-cost elemental off-hand with catalyst optionality and less absolute capital risk than premium weapons.
top_candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 elemental mechanics bypass or obsolete legacy earth-tome utility.

top_candidates.name: Nightmare staff
top_candidates.thesis: Legacy elemental hardware is a credible Raid 4 beneficiary and Nightmare staff has lower unit cost and less crowding than Harmonised hardware.
top_candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 mechanics or reward details clearly displace standard-spell legacy staffs, or liquidity deteriorates materially.

top_candidates.name: Inquisitor's great helm
top_candidates.thesis: Inquisitor armour benefits in both modeled scenarios where Raid 4 materially raises Crush relevance; armour is preferred over betting solely on the mace.
top_candidates.invalidation: Raid 4 encounter design does not reward Crush accuracy/damage enough to alter armour demand.

top_candidates.name: Wrath rune
top_candidates.thesis: Asymmetric payoff if Wrath is selected as Breaker's charge rune, but the beneficiary remains explicitly unconfirmed.
top_candidates.invalidation: Jagex confirms another charge rune/resource or changes Breaker charging mechanics away from Wrath.

top_candidates.name: Dexterous prayer scroll
top_candidates.thesis: Reduced CoX supply gives a recovery path, but current tape must demonstrate stabilization before meaningful allocation.
top_candidates.invalidation: Reduced supply does not overcome demand/inventory pressure or the scroll establishes a lower structural range.

all_candidates.invalidation: Price fails to stabilize despite reduced supply or demand structurally weakens further.

all_candidates.name: Tome of water (empty)

all_candidates.invalidation: Catalyst utility narrows away from water spells or price remains structurally crowded.

allocation_note: Suggested item sizing is a maximum percentage of liquid GP, not a target. Apply the lower of item and theme caps; leave the remainder in cash when entries are not met.
execution_rule: PARK_NOW requires fresh, non-crossed RuneLite prints. Crossed/asynchronous current prints are watch-only; staleish candidates may remain patient deep bids but not market buys.
